description: An agent-based model simulating user behavior in providing ratings and reviews across different platforms (Amazon, Goodreads, Yelp). The model focuses on user preference learning and behavior modeling through multi-agent interactions.

behaviors.name: write_review
behaviors.description: The user writes a review for a product based on their preferences and past experiences.
behaviors.algorithm: Use LLM to generate review text based on user preferences, product attributes, and historical reviews.

behaviors.name: rate_product
behaviors.description: The user rates a product on a scale of 1-5 stars.
behaviors.algorithm: Predict star rating using a weighted average of user preferences and product past ratings.

behaviors.name: receive_review
behaviors.description: The product receives a review and updates its average rating.
behaviors.algorithm: Update average rating using a weighted moving average with the new rating.

interactions.name: review_interaction
interactions.description: A user writes a review and rates a product, influencing its average rating.
interactions.effect: The product's average rating is updated and the review is added to the review history.

data_sources.name: amazon_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Training data for simulating Amazon reviews

data_sources.name: goodreads_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Training data for simulating Goodreads reviews

data_sources.name: yelp_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Training data for simulating Yelp reviews

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Entry point for running the simulation

files.name: user_agent.py
files.description: Defines the User agent's attributes and behaviors

files.name: product_agent.py
files.description: Defines the Product agent's attributes and behaviors

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Contains functions for evaluating simulation outcomes

evaluation_metrics: 1−Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of predicted star ratings
1 - (Emotional Tone Error * 0.25 + Sentiment Attitude Error * 0.25 + Topic Relevance Error * 0.5)
